```{r setup, echo=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
source("cholera_climate_review/Analysis/utils.R")
library(gtsummary)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)


# Load the dataset from the file path
data <- readr::read_csv(params$data_path)
```

# Exposure summary
```{r}
# Total number of observational studies
total_studies <- n_distinct(data$studykey)

exposure_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, exp_class) %>%
  count(exp_class, name = "n_studies") %>%
  add_row(exp_class = "Total", n_studies = total_studies)

exposure_counts %>%
  rename(Exposure = exp_class, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = `Number of Studies`) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "Number of Studies") %>%
  relocate(Metric) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Exposure Count Summary") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Metric, decimals = 0)

```

# Outcome summary
```{r}
# Outcome counts
outcome_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_metric) %>%
  count(out_class_metric, name = "n_studies") %>%
  add_row(out_class_metric = "Total", n_studies = total_studies)

outcome_counts %>%
  rename(`Outcome` = out_class_metric, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Overall Outcome Summary") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Number of Studies`, decimals = 0)

```

## Outcome summary by exposure
```{r}
outcome_tbl <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_metric, exp_class) %>%
  count(out_class_metric, exp_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exp_class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(Outcome = out_class_metric)

outcome_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Outcome Summary by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Outcome, decimals = 0)

```

# Study period summary 
```{r}
period_table <- data %>% 
  mutate(across(c("eff_tl", "eff_tr"), ~ char_to_date(.) %>% as.Date())) %>% 
  mutate(study_year_tl = lubridate::year(eff_tl),
         study_year_tr = lubridate::year(eff_tr)) %>% 
  mutate(duration = as.numeric(eff_tr-eff_tl)) %>% 
  mutate(study_duration = case_when(
    duration <= 366 ~ "Less than a year",
    duration <=366*5 ~ "1-5 years",
    TRUE ~ "> 5 year"
  )) 

```

## Study period coverage 
```{r}
period_table %>%
  summarize(
    `Earliest Study Year` = min(study_year_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Latest Study Year` = max(study_year_tr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Overall Study Period Coverage") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0)
```
### Study period by exposure
```{r}
period_table %>% 
  group_by(exp_class) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Earliest Study Year` = min(study_year_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Latest Study Year` = max(study_year_tr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Exposure = exp_class) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Earliest Study Year`, `Latest Study Year`), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = Value) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Period by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Metric, decimals = 0)

```

## Study period length
```{r}
period_table %>%
  distinct(studykey, study_duration) %>%
  count(study_duration, name = "n_studies") %>%
  rename(`Study Duration` = study_duration, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Duration Summary") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Number of Studies`, decimals = 0)

```

### Study period length by exposure
```{r}
period_tbl <- period_table %>% 
  distinct(studykey,study_duration,exp_class) %>%
  count(study_duration, exp_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exp_class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(`Study duration` = study_duration)

period_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Duration Summary by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -`Study duration`, decimals = 0)

```

# Study locations summary 
## Study locations by continent
```{r}
region_table <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, eff_country, new_admin) %>%
  rename(admin_level = new_admin) %>%
  add_continent(country_col = "eff_country") %>%
  distinct(studykey, continent) %>%
  count(continent, name = "n_studies")

region_table %>%
  rename(`Continent` = continent, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Locations by Continent") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Number of Studies`, decimals = 0)

```

### Study locations by continent by exposure
```{r}
continent_tbl <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, eff_country, new_admin,exp_class) %>%
  rename(admin_level=new_admin) %>% 
  add_continent(country_col = "eff_country") %>%
  distinct(exp_class, studykey, continent) %>%
  count(continent, exp_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exp_class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  rename(Continent = continent)

continent_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Locations by Continent and Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Continent, decimals = 0)

```

spatial_counts %>%

```{r}
spatial_scale_tbl <- data %>%

```


# Study population summary
```{r}
case_class <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_case_presentation) %>%
  mutate(case_type = case_when(
    out_class_case_presentation == "bacteriologically confirmed cases only" ~ "Confirmed",
    out_class_case_presentation == "suspected cases only" ~ "Suspected",
    out_class_case_presentation == "not stated" ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  )) %>%
  count(case_type, name = "n_studies")

case_class %>%
  rename(`Case Type` = case_type, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Population by Case Type") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Number of Studies`, decimals = 0)

```


## Study population summary by exposure
```{r}
case_class_tbl <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_case_presentation,exp_class) %>%
  mutate(case_type = case_when(
    out_class_case_presentation == "bacteriologically confirmed cases only" ~ "Confirmed",
    out_class_case_presentation == "suspected cases only" ~ "Suspected",
    out_class_case_presentation == "not stated" ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  )) %>% 
  count(case_type, exp_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exp_class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  rename("Case type" = case_type)

case_class_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Population by Case Type and Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -`Case type`, decimals = 0)
```


# Paper quality distribution
```{r}
stats_all <- generate_summary_stats(data)
study_counts <- stats_all$study_counts
stats_all$quality_summary %>%
  group_by(exp_class) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Mean (IQR)` = paste0(
      round(mean(avg_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      " (", 
      quantile(avg_tot_score_est, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
      "-", 
      quantile(avg_tot_score_est, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 
      ")"
    ),
    Min = as.character(round(min(avg_tot_score_est),2)),
    Max = as.character(round(max(avg_tot_score_est),2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -exp_class, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_class, values_from = Value) %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(title = "Distribution of Total Quality Score at the Paper level")
```


# Paper quality summary
```{r}
score_summary_by_exp <- stats_all$quality_summary %>%
  mutate(
    score_range = case_when(
      avg_tot_score_est == 11 ~ "Score = 11",
      avg_tot_score_est == 5 ~ "Score = 5",
      avg_tot_score_est >5 & avg_tot_score_est < 11 ~ "Score >5 – <11"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(exp_class, score_range) %>%
  summarize(n = sum(n_studies, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(`Score Range` = score_range)

score_summary_by_exp %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Summary of Total Quality Scores by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -`Score Range`, decimals = 0)

```

# Direction of effect and vote counting summary
```{r}
vote_counts <- stats_all$vote_counting_summary
```

## Temperature

```{r}
vc_temp <- vote_counts %>% filter(exposure == "temperature")

vc_temp %>%
  select(-exposure) %>%  # optional: drop exposure column if redundant
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(., "_", " ") %>% str_to_title()) %>%  # pretty column names
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Vote Counting Summary for Temperature") %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = where(is.numeric),
    decimals = 2
  )

```

- **Positive**: `r vc_temp$direction_counts[[1]]["positive"]`  
- **Negative**: `r vc_temp$direction_counts[[1]]["negative"]`  
- **No Effect**: `r vc_temp$direction_counts[[1]]["none"]`  
- **Null hypothesis**: `r ifelse(vc_temp$p_value < 0.05, paste0("rejected (p = ", round(vc_temp$p_value, 3), ")"), paste0("not rejected (p = ", round(vc_temp$p_value, 3), ")"))`
